info.title: Cloud API message bus
info.description: Every channel a client of the platform subscribes to or registers on the broker. A row of the REST document hands out the topic of a channel in its meta.topics, keyed by the channel's id.

test.description: MQTT 5 over secure WebSockets at wss://ws.test.vion.swiss/ws.

integrator.certificate.state.description: The validity of a gateway's certificate, published each time the gateway reports it.

integrator.certificateRequest.state.description: A gateway's certificate renewal request, published each time its status changes.

integrator.commissioning.state.description: The commissioning of a gateway, published each time its status changes.

integrator.softwareDeployment.state.description: A software deployment to a gateway, published each time its status changes.

integrator.supportGrant.state.description: A support access grant the integrator requested, published each time its status changes.

integrator.supportSession.state.description: A support session of the integrator, published each time its status changes.

integrator.systemHealth.state.description: The health of a gateway and its components, published each time the gateway reports it.

me.lastWill.event.description: The subscriber's will. A client registers it at CONNECT and publishes it, empty, before a clean disconnect; it ends the subscriber's registrations.

identityProviderUserId.description: The person's or service account's id in the identity provider, which is also its broker username.

me.notification.event.description: A nudge that the person's notifications changed, published once a notification for them is stored; it carries no notification.

identityProviderUserId.description: The person's or service account's id in the identity provider, which is also its broker username.

tenant.alert.state.description: An alert of an alert rule, published when it is raised and when it is resolved.

tenant.consoleSession.state.description: A console remote access session on the gateway, published each time its status changes.

tenant.logLevel.state.description: The log level of a component of the gateway, published each time the gateway reports it.

tenant.serviceProperty.state.description: The values of a service's properties, published by the gateway to the subscribers registered for them: the current values on registration, then each change.

serviceProviderIdentifier.description: The identifier of the service provider that declares the service.

serviceIdentifier.description: The service's identifier, unique within its service provider.

tenant.supportGrant.state.description: A support access grant of the gateway, published each time its status changes.

tenant.supportSession.state.description: A support session on the gateway, published each time its status changes.

tenant.syncStatus.state.description: How far the gateway has applied what was sent to it, published each time a sync status changes.

tenant.systemEvent.event.description: A system event of the gateway, published as the gateway reports it.

tenant.systemHealth.state.description: The health of a gateway and its components, published each time the gateway reports it.

tenant.vpnSession.state.description: A VPN remote access session on the gateway, published each time its status changes.

LastWill.name: LastWill
LastWill.summary: The client's will, which the broker publishes empty when the client's connection ends without a clean disconnect.
LastWill.description: A client registers it as the will of its MQTT CONNECT and publishes it itself, empty, before a clean disconnect, which makes the broker discard the will.
